map.在左侧用 Markdown 缩进书写层级，右侧实时生成思维导图，支持缩放、拖拽与: Write hierarchy with Markdown indentation on the left and the mind map generates live on the right, supporting zoom, drag and export.
map.填写「Markdown 编辑区Tab 增加层级 / Shift+Tab 减少」。: Fill in "Markdown editing area: Tab increases level / Shift+Tab decreases".
map.做读书笔记或头脑风暴时，用 # 标题与 - 列表的缩进直接表达层级，右侧自动生成: When taking reading notes or brainstorming, express hierarchy directly with # headings and - lists plus indentation, and the right pane generates the mind map automatically, faster than drawing nodes by hand.
map.整理会议议题时，把中心主题放在一级、讨论点放在子级，缩进越深层级越深，结构一目了: When organizing meeting topics, put the central theme at level one and discussion points at sub-levels; deeper indentation means deeper hierarchy, making the structure clear at a glance.
map.准备汇报大纲时，先把要点写成 Markdown 大纲再导出图片，配合缩放、拖拽、: When preparing a presentation outline, write the key points as a Markdown outline first and export an image, then present with zoom, drag and node folding/expanding.
map.示例：用缩进语法写一张思维导图: Example: write a mind map with indentation syntax
map.：# 产品规划\n## 用户增长\n- 渠道投放\n- 活动裂变\n## 体验优:
: # Product planning
## User growth
- Channel campaigns
- Referral campaigns
## Experience optimization
- Performance

Write with indentation on the left and the map generates live on the right; scroll to zoom, drag to pan, and click a node dot to collapse/expand children. Before exporting PNG, click "fit to screen" so everything shows.
map.用 # 表示标题层级、用 - 列表表示子节点，缩进越多层级越深；Tab 键可快速: Use # for heading levels and - lists for child nodes; deeper indentation means deeper hierarchy; the Tab key quickly indents to adjust affiliation.
map.怎么导出完整思维导图？: How to export the complete mind map?
map.支持导出 SVG 与 PNG；导出 PNG 前建议先点「适应屏幕」，确保所有内容: Supports SVG and PNG export; before exporting PNG, click "fit to screen" first so everything stays inside the canvas, and drafts are saved in localStorage.
